entity.description: single entity card or identifier resolution

relationship-page.description: one page of a relationship or of assertions about a subject

evidence-trace.description: assertion with one page of evidence locators, snapshots and sources

claim-report.description: claim or report view with bounded occurrence/citation pages

operations.name: AssertionEvidenceTrace
operations.document: fragment EvidenceLocator on SourceLocator { endOffset exact mediaEndSeconds mediaStartSeconds page prefix selectorKind snapshot(limit: 1) { captureCompleteness contentHash language mimeType publishedAt retrievedAt source(limit: 1) { canonicalUri genre name sourceKind uid } uid } startOffset suffix uid } fragment PageInfoFields on PageInfo { endCursor hasNextPage } fragment SubjectRef on Subjectable { __typename name uid } query AssertionEvidenceTrace($after: String, $first: Int = 10, $uid: String!) { assertions(where: {uid: {eq: $uid}}, limit: 1) { adjudications(limit: 5, sort: [{recordedAt: DESC}]) { adjudicationKind mechanicalStatus policyOutcome recordedAt uid verdict } assertedBy(limit: 1) { ...SubjectRef } assertionKind basisKind claimType evidenceConnection(first: $first, after: $after, sort: [{node: {uid: ASC}}]) { edges { cursor node { ...EvidenceLocator } properties { authority expectedSelectedContentDigest facet independence origin role } } pageInfo { ...PageInfoFields } totalCount } object(limit: 1) { ...SubjectRef } polarity predicate proposition qualifiers recordedAt recordedTo speechAct status subject(limit: 1) { ...SubjectRef } uid unitCode validFrom validTo valueBoolean valueNumber valueString } }

operations.name: ClaimView
operations.document: fragment SubjectRef on Subjectable { __typename name uid } query ClaimView($first: Int = 10, $uid: String!) { claims(where: {uid: {eq: $uid}}, limit: 1) { assessments(limit: 10, sort: [{recordedAt: DESC}]) { assessmentKind assessmentSubkind certainty grade recordedAt status summary uid verdict } claimType discourseDerivedAt discourseFirstHandCount discourseFirstOccurrenceAt discourseIndependentCount discourseMethodVersion discourseRecutCount discourseRetellingCount latestVerdict lifecycleState occurrencesConnection( first: $first sort: [{node: {recordedAt: DESC}}, {node: {uid: ASC}}] ) { edges { node { assertedBy(limit: 1) { ...SubjectRef } polarity predicate recordedAt speechAct status uid } } totalCount } proposition propositionHash reports(limit: 10, sort: [{publishedAt: DESC}]) { citationCompleteness citationCorrectness distinctSourceFamilyCount independentSourceFamilyCount policyOutcome publishedAt reportKind status uid verdict } uid } }

operations.name: EntityCard
operations.document: query EntityCard($uid: String!) { entities(where: {uid: {eq: $uid}}, limit: 1) { __typename createdAt name privacyClass uid updatedAt ... on Biomarker { biomarkerKind description } ... on ChemicalSubstance { molecularFormula molecularWeight substanceClass } ... on Condition { conditionKind description } ... on IngredientMaterial { brandName materialKind physicalForm } ... on Organization { description jurisdiction legalName organizationKind status } ... on Person { credentialsVerbatim description publicActorBasis } ... on Product { jurisdiction marketedName productKind } ... on Study { acronym overallStatus phase studyKind } } }

operations.name: PackageLabelHistoryPage
operations.document: fragment PageInfoFields on PageInfo { endCursor hasNextPage } query PackageLabelHistoryPage($after: String, $first: Int = 10, $packageUid: String!) { packages(where: {uid: {eq: $packageUid}}, limit: 1) { labelVersionsConnection( first: $first after: $after sort: [{edge: {validFrom: DESC}}, {node: {uid: ASC}}] ) { edges { cursor node { compositionDigest containsAllergens contentDigest directionsText firstObservedAt jurisdiction labelVersionCode lastObservedAt panelKind servingSizeVerbatim servingsPerContainer uid warningsText } properties { recordedFrom recordedTo validFrom validFromPrecision validTo validToPrecision } } pageInfo { ...PageInfoFields } totalCount } name packageKind uid } }

operations.name: ProductCard
operations.document: fragment PageInfoFields on PageInfo { endCursor hasNextPage } query ProductCard($uid: String!) { products(where: {uid: {eq: $uid}}, limit: 1) { brand(limit: 1) { brandKind name owners(limit: 5, sort: [{uid: ASC}]) { name uid } uid } createdAt jurisdiction marketedName name privacyClass productKind uid updatedAt variantsConnection(first: 10, sort: [{node: {uid: ASC}}]) { edges { node { dosageForm flavor jurisdiction name strengthVerbatim uid } } pageInfo { ...PageInfoFields } totalCount } } }

operations.name: ProductLabelHistory
operations.document: fragment PageInfoFields on PageInfo { endCursor hasNextPage } query ProductLabelHistory($first: Int = 5, $uid: String!) { products(where: {uid: {eq: $uid}}, limit: 1) { name uid variants(limit: 5, sort: [{uid: ASC}]) { name packages(limit: 3, sort: [{uid: ASC}]) { labelVersionsConnection( first: $first sort: [{edge: {validFrom: DESC}}, {node: {uid: ASC}}] ) { edges { cursor node { contentDigest firstObservedAt jurisdiction labelVersionCode lastObservedAt panelKind servingSizeVerbatim uid } properties { recordedFrom recordedTo validFrom validFromPrecision validTo validToPrecision } } pageInfo { ...PageInfoFields } totalCount } name packageKind uid } uid } } }

operations.name: ProductVariantsPage
operations.document: fragment PageInfoFields on PageInfo { endCursor hasNextPage } query ProductVariantsPage($after: String, $first: Int = 25, $uid: String!) { products(where: {uid: {eq: $uid}}, limit: 1) { uid variantsConnection(first: $first, after: $after, sort: [{node: {uid: ASC}}]) { edges { cursor node { dosageForm flavor jurisdiction name packages(limit: 5, sort: [{uid: ASC}]) { name packageKind uid unitCount unitNoun } strengthVerbatim uid } properties { orderIndex } } pageInfo { ...PageInfoFields } totalCount } } }

operations.name: ReportView
operations.document: fragment PageInfoFields on PageInfo { endCursor hasNextPage } fragment SubjectRef on Subjectable { __typename name uid } query ReportView($after: String, $first: Int = 10, $uid: String!) { reports(where: {uid: {eq: $uid}}, limit: 1) { about(limit: 10) { ...SubjectRef } bodyDigest citationCompleteness citationCorrectness citesAssertionsConnection( first: $first after: $after sort: [{node: {uid: ASC}}] ) { edges { cursor node { polarity predicate proposition recordedAt status uid } } pageInfo { ...PageInfoFields } totalCount } distinctSourceFamilyCount independentSourceFamilyCount policyOutcome policyVersion publishedAt recordedAt reportKind skeletonKey status uid unsupportedHighSeverityCount verdict worldCorrectness } }

operations.name: ResolveIdentifier
operations.document: fragment SubjectRef on Subjectable { __typename name uid } query ResolveIdentifier($scheme: String!, $value: String!) { identifiers(where: {scheme: {eq: $scheme}, value: {eq: $value}}, limit: 5) { identifies(limit: 10, sort: [{uid: ASC}]) { ...SubjectRef } issuer normalizationRule scheme uid validFrom validTo value } }
